units.source_text: “对，拿黑色来说吧，就有各种各样。”

en.t: "Yes, take black, for instance; there are all kinds of it."

units.source_text: 宗助点了点头，“尽管如此，今天我也在想：

en.t: Sosuke nodded. "Even so, today I was thinking:

units.source_text: 腰带商人中也有像伊津仓先生那样的人……

en.t: among obi merchants, there are people like Mr. Itsukura too...

units.source_text: 他那里盖了一栋四层楼的洋房，搞现代工业。

en.t: He has built a four-story Western-style building there and is running a modern industry.

units.source_text: 西阵大概也要那样发展，一天能产五百条腰带，不久的将来，职工还要参加经营。

en.t: Nishijin will probably develop that way too, producing five hundred obi a day, and before long the workers will take part in management as well.

units.source_text: 他们的平均年龄，据说都在二十岁上下。

en.t: Their average age, I hear, is around twenty.

units.source_text: 像我们这种手织机的家庭手工业，也许用不了二三十年就会全部被淘汰呢。”

en.t: Cottage industries with hand looms like ours may all be swept away within twenty or thirty years."
